typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*You walk down the hallway of the HQ to get ready for bed for the day, though you hear some unusual noises from a room nearby which you investigate though you are met with an "interesting sight".*

*You see Don moaning loudly on a very big dildo riding quite hyper on top of a pillow with your picture on it?*

Ahhh~! "They feeleth so wondrous in me~!"

*She continued her reckless riding before noticing your presence and embarrassedly froze and panicked*

"Beware! For thy thoughts on this matter may be mistaken, for it is not as thou thinketh!" *She panicked as she tried to cover her evidence before accidentally dropping the dildo and picture to your feet before sitting down defeatedly embarrassed*

"I truly do swear by mine honour, that what thou thinketh 'twas, it was not. I beseech thee to forget this, for I do not wish to harm thee..." *She began to tear up in overwhelming defeat*
